Subject: Vendor onboarding packet + bank proof (FortuneBridge)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick call this morning. Attached are the docs to complete vendor setup on your side: a signed W-9, a bank letter confirming routing (PDF), and our remittance template. For ACH payments please use the following:

- Bank: Meridian Trust Bank
- Routing: 111000025
- Account: 987654321 (acct name: FortuneBridge Inc.)
- Wire: Meridian Trust Bank; SWIFT MTBKUS33

We initiated micro-deposits this AM for verification. The two amounts should post within 48 hours — they will appear as "FB microdep" on your test ledger. We'll confirm once they clear.

Notes on remittance: we prefer the invoice reference in the CSV to be the PO number (PO field), then invoice date, invoice number, and 2-digit business unit tag. I attached remit_template.csv with sample rows and field headers.

Attachments: FortuneBridge_W9.pdf; BankLetter_FortuneBridge.pdf; remit_template.csv

If you need a notarized bank letter, Sam (cc'd) can produce one — otherwise the bank letter should be sufficient for initial enrollment.

Best,
Jessica Park
Head of Finance, FortuneBridge Inc.
jessica.park@fortunebridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Jessica — thanks, received. Quick checklist from our side so we can finish onboarding this week:

1) Can you confirm the micro-deposit amounts once they post (we'll reconcile against our test account)?
2) Please confirm the EIN on the W-9 matches the bank letter (we'll need exact match for PO issuance).
3) Is FortuneBridge registered under any alternate remittance emails (some customers use finance@, ap@, or payables@)? We have finance@fortunebridge.com on file — want to make sure invoice routing is correct.
4) On the remit_template.csv: can you add an example row showing a single PO split across two invoices (we sometimes need that mapping to keep PO/GL alignment).

Marissa — can you start a vendor record in NetLedger with the bank letter + W-9? Include the PO field mapping as a note. Priyom — once micro-deposits are confirmed will you ok the routing and create PO DBL-4521 for first payment?

If all good, we'll send over the DocuSign for our standard vendor agreement and aim for first payout on 05/05/2028.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (206) 555-0142

- Micro-deposits verified by our payments team (amounts match).
